meta.description: Complete Goetsusioji spelling → component glyph mapping. Each entry lists the glyph sequence per 拼寫規則 layout slots.
meta.collision_policy: Romanization string is the lookup key. When the same string arises from more than one decomposition (e.g. tiu = t+iu simple vs t+i+u medial), the first tier wins (simple > implicit_i > with_medial > compound). Other decompositions are listed under alternates.
